name: p2-search-stop-d
note: P2/long_use#2 in campaign 4 burned all 8 requests on seven reworded memory searches (reading group, book club, Birch Room, get-together venue, party venue pub restaurant, reading, gathering place meeting) and failed with bound_exceeded. The guidance only says to search; it never says when to stop. This adds a stop rule to the same sentence.

edits.find: and when a memory points to something else, such as a place or an object, search for that too.
edits.replace: and when a memory points to something else, such as a place or an object, search for that too. Two searches are usually enough: once a search has returned the memory that answers the request, use it and answer instead of searching again with reworded queries.
